content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in Anchorage

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: PMI requires a combination of formal education and project-management experience. Review PMI's specific requirements for your background—whether you hold a bachelor's degree, associate degree, or high school diploma affects how many years of documented project experience you'll need to demonstrate. Verify your qualifications before enrolling.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours of Training
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP Certification Training course. Our nationally delivered program covers the full PMBOK Guide framework across multiple sessions. You'll earn all 35 PMI contact hours required for exam eligibility while learning from active certified practitioners in a collaborative online classroom.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After course completion, submit your formal PMP application directly to PMI, including proof of education, project experience, and contact-hour completion. Pay the associated PMI exam fee. Allow time for PMI to review and approve your application—this step confirms you meet all prerequisites before you sit for the exam.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Sit for the Exam
steps_items.text: Access Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources, including practice questions, study guides, and instructor Q&A sessions designed to reinforce key concepts. Schedule your proctored PMP exam through PMI's testing partner. Test centers are available throughout the Anchorage area, and remote testing is also an option.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your PMP Credential
steps_items.text: After earning your PMP, commit to the 3-year renewal cycle by earning professional development units (PDUs) across project management, leadership, and strategic business expertise. Renew your credential and continuing education requirements on PMI's renewal schedule to keep your certification active and demonstrate ongoing expertise to employers.

fq_items.question: What are the PMP eligibility requirements?
fq_items.answer: PMI sets four eligibility paths based on education: a secondary diploma (high school or equivalent) requires 60 months of project leadership experience; an associate's degree requires 48 months; a bachelor's degree requires 36 months; and a bachelor's or postgraduate degree from a PMI Global Accreditation Center (GAC)-accredited program requires just 24 months. Every path also requires 35 hours of project management education — our course satisfies this requirement in full.

fq_items.question: How long does it take to get PMP certified in {city}?
fq_items.answer: After completing training, PMI typically approves applications within 5–10 business days. Once approved, you have one year to sit for the exam. Most students study 4–8 weeks after the course before scheduling their exam.

fq_items.question: What is your pass guarantee?
fq_items.answer: If you complete our course and do not pass the PMP exam within 90 days, we provide additional coaching sessions at no additional cost until you pass.
